translations.en: We cannot tell whether it still retains
its power today.
It would be cruel to raise their hopes
only to disappoint them. @7rCarmine@0r in particular would make a great fuss.
With that in mind, will you take the job?
What are you doing?
You're the only ones we can rely on now.
Please...
We don't know what will happen if this seal is broken.
The seal on the ruins themselves may still hold,
or the world may come to an end.
Unless we stop @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master's@0r plot,
@7rChu Lu Gah's@0r seal will be broken,
and I fear the whole world will vanish, not just this city.
I feel awkward presenting this as a request from me,
but please think of it as a request from everyone in this city.
Please defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r
and stop their plot.
Should something this important really be entrusted to mere adventurers?
When you ask, @7rBeatrix@0r smiles.
This may be our last gamble,
but I entrust this city's fate to you.
If you give it everything you have and still fail, I can accept that.
We aren't up to the task. As far as I know,
you're the only ones I can entrust it to... Do your best.
I'm asking you too.
I'm sure you can defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
Give it your best shot.
But please don't push yourselves too hard.
Is that too much to ask?
But, um, anyway, please do your best without overdoing it!
I wish I could help,
but I'd only get in your way in a fight.
Like @7rTanya@0r said, don't push yourselves too hard.

translations.en: Don't get yourselves killed.
There is clearly no room to refuse.
You must defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
Your objective could not be clearer.
You set out to find the two monsters,
heading into the final labyrinth.
You received @3rCrimson Flash@0r.
You look pale. What happened?
You tell @7rBeatrix@0r and the others
what @7rLady Marbas@0r said.
@7rLady Marbas@0r just vanished like that?
Then... did she die?
Unable to speak, you lower your head.
I see. Thank you for this valuable information, at any rate.
To think the monsters are becoming more active...
From now on, let's focus on protecting the settlement
and avoid venturing too far into the labyrinths.
You did defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
You should be proud of your skills.
And... if @7rLady Marbas@0r is dead,
don't waste the lives she saved...
Here's your reward. Please take it.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received a reward of @3r200,000 G@0r and @3rCrimson Flash@0r.
@7rBeatrix@0r is right.
You cannot waste the lives @7rLady Marbas@0r saved.
She said one final seal still remains...
But where is it? And can you reach it in time?
No, there is still time.
Holding on to that belief, you rise
to prepare for the final battle.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received a reward of @3r200,000 G@0r.
We don't have time to take things slowly.
I have a favor to ask. May I?
I'd like you to check whether @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r seal
has truly been broken.
If it hasn't been broken completely,
we might still be able to restore it, wouldn't you say?
It won't hurt to make certain.
I'm counting on you.
@7rBeatrix's@0r relentless demands leave you speechless,
but she does have a point.
If the seal has not been broken completely,
it might still be possible to repair and reinforce it.
You hesitate at the thought of returning to the seal in the depths,
but this is no time to indulge your preferences.

context: The residents entrust the city's fate to the party; Beatrix reacts to Lady Marbas's disappearance and asks for a seal check.
